content.value_statement: Website teams often struggle to organize pages, navigation, and URLs. This skill creates clear hierarchies, visual sitemaps, URL maps, and linking plans.
actual_capabilities: Creates page hierarchy plans for SaaS, content, e-commerce, documentation, hybrid, and local sites.
Builds ASCII site trees and Mermaid visual sitemap diagrams.
Recommends URL patterns for pages, categories, integrations, comparisons, docs, and landing pages.
Defines header navigation, footer navigation, sidebars, breadcrumbs, and mobile navigation patterns.
Plans hub-and-spoke internal linking and identifies orphan page risks.
Maps pages to URLs, parents, navigation locations, and priorities.
limitations: Does not generate or submit XML sitemaps for search engines.
Does not crawl live websites or verify current URLs automatically.
Requires business goals, audience details, and page inventory for best results.
Does not replace technical SEO audits, analytics review, or user research.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Marketing Site
use_cases.description: Create the first page hierarchy, navigation model, URL plan, and launch-ready sitemap.

use_cases.title: Restructure a Growing Website
use_cases.description: Group existing pages, reduce navigation complexity, preserve key URLs, and plan redirects.

use_cases.title: Design Scaled SEO Sections
use_cases.description: Place integration, comparison, category, or resource pages into hubs without cluttering navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Site Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new website.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the site architecture for a new website. Ask me for any missing business goals, audience details, and core pages first.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Visual Sitemap
prompt_templates.scenario: Share a sitemap with design or content teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a visual sitemap for this website structure. Include a page hierarchy, Mermaid diagram, and navigation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Navigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Reorganize a website with many pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this current page list and propose a cleaner architecture. Include before and after structures, URL changes, and redirect notes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Scaled Content Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for programmatic or large content sections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design architecture for a site adding many integration and comparison pages. Include hub pages, URL patterns, navigation placement, and internal links.

output_examples.input: A SaaS site needs homepage, pricing, features, blog, docs, integrations, and comparison pages.
output: A structured page hierarchy with core pages near the homepage.
A URL map using consistent feature, blog, docs, integration, and comparison paths.
Header, footer, breadcrumb, and internal linking recommendations.

output_examples.input: A 50 page website has unclear navigation and users cannot find important content.
output: A content inventory approach before changing navigation.
A simplified navigation model with grouped sections and dropdown guidance.
Redirect planning for moved pages and orphan page prevention.

output_examples.input: A content team wants a design-ready visual sitemap for a new resource hub.
output: A Mermaid sitemap showing hubs, categories, and key pages.
A priority table for page placement in header, footer, and sidebar navigation.
Internal linking recommendations between hub pages and supporting content.

best_practices: Provide goals, audience segments, page inventory, and must-keep URLs before requesting a redesign.
Use the URL map and hierarchy together so breadcrumbs, navigation, and paths stay aligned.
Review the proposed structure with design, content, SEO, and engineering stakeholders before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for XML sitemap generation, crawl errors, or technical SEO troubleshooting.
Do not ask for a final architecture without sharing current pages or business priorities.
Do not place every important page in the header navigation.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates page hierarchies, URL maps, navigation specs, visual sitemaps, and internal linking plans.

faq.question: Can it redesign an existing website structure?
faq.answer: Yes. It can reorganize existing pages, suggest grouping, and flag URLs that may need redirects.

faq.question: Does it create XML sitemaps?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on human-facing site architecture, not XML sitemap files or crawl diagnostics.

faq.question: Can it help with SEO pages at scale?
faq.answer: Yes. It can place scaled pages into hubs and define clean URL and linking patterns.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide site goals, target audiences, planned pages, current URLs, and important conversion paths.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
